title: smilax ovatorotunda var. ussuriensis
intro: Smilax ovatorotunda var. ussuriensis, commonly known as Chinese sarsaparilla, is a perennial vine native to China and Russia, belonging to the Smilacaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Smilax ovatorotunda var. ussuriensis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which contribute to its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
